pick.name: Claude Design
pick.what: Chat-to-design canvas: prototypes, wireframes, one-pagers, decks; imports your design system; hands off to Claude Code
pick.why: Hands off prototypes directly to Claude Code and reads a codebase design system.
pick.free_limits: Available on Free, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise (on by default); usage counts toward Claude plan limits. Now an artifact template in Claude chats and Claude Code (/design); standalone claude.ai/design closes 14 Dec 2026
pick.maintained: live; standalone claude.ai/design closes 14 Dec 2026 and moves into Claude

best_free.what: Google Labs AI UI design with MCP server/SDK, export to AI Studio/Antigravity/Netlify
best_free.why: Free and does not consume Claude usage; use for bulk screen exploration.
best_free.free_limits: Free; monthly generation quota not published

details: Prototyping slot merged here: Claude Design prototypes are clickable HTML.

verify.note: Support doc says it is available on the Free plan, so it is not paid-only. The close date was confirmed.
